title: Samsung WD53 — Smart Install entry
description: Enter Smart Install (AS) from Hidden Mode or Product Care Self Clean+ tap sequence.

steps.title: Standby — empty drum
steps.body: Combo standby. Drum empty. Access Hidden Mode or Product Care.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Combo standby. Drum empty. Access Hidden Mode or Product Care.

steps.title: Enter Smart Install
steps.body: Hidden Mode → Smart Install, OR Product Care → Self Clean+ tap 25× (tabs within 1 s). Password: washerdryer.1! Display shows AS with Micom/LCD versions.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Smart Install active when AS displays.
